2609.20732.title: Q&A on Any Spreadsheet Requires Interpreting Its Grid Structure
2609.20732.paper_summary: Semantic cell annotation improves chunking interpretability for spreadsheets in LLM-driven RAG systems, aiding answer generation through enriched context rather than improved retrieval accuracy. We propose a novel framework of splitting any spreadsheet into interpretable chunks using cell role annotation. Our framework beats the state of the art, yet it faces a hard ceiling. Spreadsheets are fundamentally two-dimensional unstructured data with continuous relationships and infinite potential cell roles. Because classification models are restricted to finite, pre-defined classes, they cannot perfectly capture this structural nuance, even with human-level annotation. We show that addressing the spreadsheet-to-LLM bottleneck requires moving beyond discrete cell classification. Instead, the field must develop dimensionality-reduction techniques to directly flatten 2D unstructured spreadsheets into 1D unstructured text. Text chunks would be easier for downstream RAG to interpret and generate from.
2609.20732.paper_summary_zh: 語義單元註釋提高了LLM驅動的RAG系統中電子表格的片段可解釋性，通過豐富的上下文而不是提高檢索準確性來幫助答案生成。<lb/>我們提出了一種新穎的框架，利用單元格角色註釋將任何電子表格拆分為可解釋的片段。<lb/>我們的框架超越了當前的技術水平，但面臨著一個嚴重的瓶頸。<lb/>電子表格本質上是具有連續關係和無限潛在單元格角色的二維非結構化數據。<lb/>由於分類模型受到有限的、預定義類別的限制，它們無法完美捕捉這種結構的細微差別，即使有達到人類水平的註釋。<lb/>我們表明，解決電子表格到LLM的瓶頸需要超越離散的單元格分類。<lb/>相反，該領域必須開發降維技術，直接將二維非結構化電子表格展平為一維非結構化文本。<lb/>文本片段將更容易被下游RAG解釋和生成。
